sentences.en: The people there are very hardworking and above all, cooperative.
sentences.zh: 那里的人们非常勤奋，尤其合作精神很强。

sentences.en: I am impatient with those who aren't cooperative.
sentences.zh: 我对那些不合作的人很不耐烦。

sentences.en: My mother attached herself to a cooperative society.

senses.zh: 合作的，协作的；愿意合作的，配合的；协同的，互助的
